justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/aztec/detector/Detector.java (the only class in this package) and core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/aztec/AztecReader.java. Detector depends outward on 5 packages (com.google.zxing, com.google.zxing.aztec, com.google.zxing.common, com.google.zxing.common.detector, com.google.zxing.common.reedsolomon), while the only production class importing it is AztecReader; a test also references Detector.Point. With such low incoming coupling, this package is not a stable package depending on less-stable ones, so UD is not present.
